title: Syno Connect Center: reach your NAS from anywhere, no port forwarding
body:
Syno Connect Center shows you, on one screen, every way your NAS can be reached from outside. If DSM's own **QuickConnect** or **DDNS** is turned on, it's listed too, for reference. Need another way in? Set up Cloudflare, Tailscale, NetBird or IPv6 direct right there in a few clicks, with no port forwarding. DSM sign-in stays on by default.

![Overview: Cloudflare and Tailscale set up here, QuickConnect and DDNS from DSM](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8f14012a-c81d-42f9-b66d-d5aee3188d73)

## The big ideas

- **Everything in one place.** Every way in gets its own line on **Overview**, with its address, a QR code and whether it's running. QuickConnect and DDNS are read from DSM and shown as they are; you still change them in DSM's Control Panel.
- **No open router ports.** Cloudflare links run through a tunnel, and Tailscale and NetBird use a private network.
- **Pick one way, or mix them.** A free workers.dev link, your own domain on Cloudflare, Tailscale (or Headscale), NetBird (including a self-hosted server) or IPv6 direct access. Each one works on its own.
- **You choose which apps are reachable.** Add Syno Package Land apps, native DSM apps or any web service on your NAS, one at a time.
- **DSM made for your phone.** Connect adds a phone version of DSM at `/m` on your NAS address. More on that below.

## 1. Start the setup wizard

On first launch, **Overview** shows your NAS on the local network. Click **Set up**.

![First visit: Set up](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2fa28baf-40d9-440c-95a5-e1d167fd63cc)

## 2. Choose how you want to connect

The wizard compares the three common choices side by side: cost, who can open it, what you need to install and whether video works well.

![Step 1: Choose how](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d4e91a38-0cd7-408c-b367-685fa6c4cb2f)

Quick guide:

- **Free link** — free, no domain needed. Good for DSM and light web apps, but not for video or large files.
- **My own domain** — a lasting address on a domain you own, through Cloudflare.
- **Only my devices** — Tailscale. Only your own signed-in phones and computers can reach the NAS. Video works fine.

Just want to try it out? **Get a temporary address** gives you a short-lived link right away.

## 3. Connect it

For a Free link, click **Open Cloudflare with the permissions filled in**. Create the token in your Cloudflare account and paste it back here. Read and tick the safety note, then click **Check and connect**. The wizard moves on by itself once the link works.

![Step 2: Connect Free link](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c19b4914-8f43-49a5-ae00-a8db41949d9f)

> Before you open DSM to the internet, turn on 2-step verification and auto block in DSM. The wizard asks you to confirm this.

Then choose which apps should be reachable and open their links.

## 4. Check the Overview

Each connection you've turned on gets its own line on **Overview**: green means it's reachable from outside and running on the NAS. Copy the address, open it or show a QR code.

![Overview with three connections](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/747761df-e077-48d3-92e5-28e78ee21b25)

## 5. Manage your apps

**App URLs** lists every app, which connections open it and its address. Click **Add app** to add another web service. If something needs attention, the app's row says what and whether it will fix itself.

![App URLs](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c85980f6-3723-402f-b484-4ddb58fd6886)

## 6. Use DSM on your phone (Mobile View)

This is the part people miss. Open the normal DSM in a phone browser and you get the desktop: tiny windows you have to pinch and zoom. With Connect installed, add `/m` to your NAS address (for example `https://mynas.quickconnect.to/m`) and you get a different page, built for phones.

![Mobile View: Home, Apps and Storage Manager](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4ff3f9bd-0fd4-4398-b759-0d3c2c2bf0ea)

- **DSM Apps, laid out for phones.** Open Storage Manager, Control Panel, File Station and your other apps from the **Apps** tab. Pages and tables fit the screen, and wide tables scroll sideways with the first column pinned.
- **Same account, same permissions.** Sign in with your usual DSM account. Nothing new to set up.
- **Live status on the home page.** CPU, memory, network and drives update live. Anything that needs attention, like a Security Advisor warning, sits at the top.
- **Notifications.** All your DSM notifications in one list, filtered by errors, warnings and info.

![Mobile View: Security Advisor, live resources and notifications](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2a879e4a-0c67-4deb-ac6c-f3c2e5da9cb8)

**How to open it:** click **Connect your phone** at the top of Overview (or scroll to **Use DSM on your phone**). Under **Connect through**, pick which way your phone should use: QuickConnect, DDNS, a Cloudflare link, Tailscale, NetBird, IPv6 or your local network. Then scan the QR code. The phone in the middle is a preview with demo data: tap it to try Security Advisor, resources and notifications.

![Use DSM on your phone: QR code, phone preview and Home Screen steps](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ca9163d4-fcfd-4380-8304-5b15ae094c70)

A few things to know about the way you pick:

- **Tailscale or NetBird:** install that app on the phone and sign in first.
- **Local network:** only works on the same network as the NAS.
- **IPv6 direct:** the browser shows a certificate warning.
- **Temporary address:** it changes when the NAS or Connect restarts.

**Make it feel like an app:** add it to your Home Screen. On iPhone, open the link in Safari, tap **Share**, then **Add to Home Screen**. On Android, open it in Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then **Add to Home screen** or **Install app**. From then on it opens full screen, with its own icon.

## Tips & FAQ

**Can I limit who opens my own-domain links?**
Yes. Under **Cloudflare › Own domain › Who can access**, turn on **Restrict access by email**. Visitors then get a one-time code by email (Cloudflare Access, Zero Trust Free). This only covers your own domain, not Free links or temporary addresses. Native apps like Synology Photos or Drive can't pass the browser email check.

![Own domain: who can access](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/10c75155-5cd7-4570-a724-0ab71f4f2c1c)

**Which way should I pick?**
Open **Overview › Compare all ways** for a full table, including QuickConnect and DDNS that are built into DSM. Using more than one connection doesn't make anything faster or add failover. Pick the one that fits.

**Does it need anything on my router?**
No, Cloudflare, Tailscale and NetBird don't. IPv6 direct is the exception: it needs IPv6 on your network, and the guide in the app walks you through it.

**Requirements:** DSM 7.2 or later. Sign in with a DSM administrator account.
